rows.implementation_summary: A GET-only Next.js workspace API route parses projectRoot, deliverablePath, and optional file, delegates to readDeliverableContent, returns the successful content result as JSON, and translates thrown workspace errors into typed status/body responses. The helper defaults file to _STATUS.md, normalizes and canonicalizes the project/deliverable roots, rejects absolute and lexical traversal paths, rechecks containment after realpath to block symlink escape, requires a regular file, then returns its content and canonical relative path.

Its helper also applies DEL-07-01 root/containment controls, while the route exists to serve DEL-02-03-style read-only deliverable inspection through a shell DocumentView. rows.rationale: Ontology: the route is a Workspace API for read-only deliverable document access, not a Harness API/SSE adapter. Epistemology: implementation and tests prove behavior, while the accepted catalogs omit the route and no live kit assigns its feature ownership. Praxeology: a distributed capability boundary best matches the code—DEL-07-03 document contract, DEL-07-01 containment, DEL-02-03 read-only UI consumption—while avoiding false transfer of control ownership. Axiology: preserving least authority and explicit uncertainty is preferable to silently treating the affinity container as owner. Because choosing or accepting the lead owner changes recorded scope/ownership, the only lawful classification is OWNER_CLASS and the mapping remains PROPOSAL.
